principle: National sources complement municipality/state parcel evidence. Municipality-level or coarse national indicators must never be rendered as parcel-specific facts.

sources.runtime_use: Censo 2022 population, density, occupied permanent households and average residents per household for the selected municipality.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipality context only; never a parcel or census-sector attribute.

sources.runtime_use: Potential administrative/district/subdistrict boundaries.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal parcel geometry remains authoritative for parcel selection.

sources.runtime_use: Official Censo 2022 GeoServer is verified as a reference source; deterministic parcel runtime uses the official IBGE 2022 census-sector GeoPackage materialized locally.
sources.parcel_rule: Always preserve territorial level and indicator definition; sector data is context, not parcel/household fact.

sources.runtime_use: Exact point-in-polygon census-sector context for the five first-wave municipalities: sector identity, population, households and average residents from the official 2022 mesh-with-attributes.
sources.parcel_rule: Sector indicators describe the census sector containing the parcel point; they are not parcel-specific or household-specific attributes.

sources.runtime_use: Regional roads, hydrography and toponymy.
sources.parcel_rule: Scale is too coarse for parcel boundary, frontage or local road alignment.

sources.runtime_use: Macro, meso and micro hydrographic region at clicked parcel.
sources.parcel_rule: Hydrographic region is not flood risk.

sources.runtime_use: Federal conservation-unit polygon incidence at parcel point.
sources.parcel_rule: No federal UC incidence does not exclude state/municipal/environmental restrictions.

sources.runtime_use: Official geoserver.car.gov.br/sicar WFS state layers provide rural-property polygon incidence and non-personal public registration metadata.
sources.parcel_rule: CAR is declaratory and not proof of ownership/title or final environmental regularity; APP/RL/use-restricted geometries require a separately verified public or authorized source.

sources.runtime_use: Official SGB ArcGIS provides municipality susceptibility-map coverage plus live parcel-point risk-sector and flood-susceptibility polygons.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal summary does not classify the parcel; parcel-point SGB geometry is complementary to higher-resolution municipal/state risk mapping.

sources.runtime_use: Official MapBiomas Collection 11 GeoTIFFs are sampled at the parcel representative point for 1985, 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025 via HTTP range/rasterio.
sources.parcel_rule: 30 m pixel history is screening context only; it does not describe the entire parcel or prove legal/licensed land use.

sources.runtime_use: Official INCRA Geoportal WFS/WMS geonode:sigef_geo is intersected with the parcel point; public certification/CNS/matricula references feed due diligence.
sources.parcel_rule: SIGEF certification/reference does not replace current registry certificate, ownership, encumbrance or chain-of-title analysis.

sources.runtime_use: Current registry certificate/matricula and encumbrance due diligence through legitimate authorized access.
sources.parcel_rule: Never index or infer current owners from unrelated public records; do not bypass authentication.

sources.runtime_use: Future authorized government interoperability/CIB/CNM integration.
sources.parcel_rule: No anonymous public parcel REST contract is treated as available.

sources.runtime_use: Indigenous-territory polygon incidence using official FUNAI WFS.
sources.parcel_rule: Territorial incidence requires legal interpretation and is not private ownership data.

sources.runtime_use: Project, contract, physical/financial progress and public-event connectors.
sources.parcel_rule: Current public geometry contract does not expose coordinates/GeoJSON sufficient for defensible parcel distance; no text-address proximity.

sources.runtime_use: RREO 2025 municipal context: realized IPTU, realized ITBI, Receita Corrente Líquida and RCL adjusted for debt-limit calculations. Cached per municipality with request throttling.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipality-level fiscal context only; never render these values as parcel tax, parcel value, owner capacity or parcel-level economics.

sources.runtime_use: Transferências Especiais 2026 resolved by the municipality institutional CNPJ: plan count, investment and operating values. Zero plans is a valid result.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipality-level transfer context only. Plan names/values are never treated as parcel works or nearby projects without official geometry.

sources.runtime_use: Cached, serialized small-radius pedestrian crossing, transit stop/platform, cycle infrastructure and bicycle-parking context.
sources.parcel_rule: Collaborative OSM data varies in completeness; official municipal layers prevail and Overpass outages never block the dossier.

sources.runtime_use: Official SNV federal-road geometry within 80 m of the parcel, with approximate metric distance and SNV version.
sources.parcel_rule: Road-centerline proximity does not prove frontage, access, legal right-of-way or federal-domain restriction on the parcel.

sources.runtime_use: Same-origin CEP lookup for address search.
sources.parcel_rule: CEP coordinates are search hints, not parcel geometry.

sources.runtime_use: Basemap, Nominatim address geocoding and 3D/base-map context.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal official cadastral geometry remains authoritative for parcel selection.
